newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bond spreads show tighter bias.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bond spreads show tighter bias.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads generally ended the year on a tighter note, although the long-end of the Canadian debt market outshone the dollar bloc.
Trading was fairly subdued in all markets ahead of the New Year holiday, although the Australain/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread just managed to scrape below resistance at the 110 basis point level.

However, traders feel that there is unlikely to be any major moves on this differential until the local data flow resumes, beginning on Monday with the November balance of payments, but even then the market will be looking ahead to the quarterly inflation report towards the end of the month.

It was Australia's much improved inflation outlook this year that triggered the dramatic narrowing in yield spreads to the U.S., touching the mid-80s after this month's surprise cut in official domestic rates to 6.0 percent, and having ended last year at 260 basis points.
